kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتواءم (form VI)
# نَتَوَاءَمُ (natawāʔamu) /na.ta.waː.ʔa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# نَتَوَاءَمَ (natawāʔama) /na.ta.waː.ʔa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
# نَتَوَاءَمْ (natawāʔam) /na.ta.waː.ʔam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاءَمَ (tawāʔama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
